bar.page_text:
Lumen Ledger
Features
Pricing
Help
Know where your household money goes

Lumen Ledger sorts your bills into 12 clear groups, so you can see each month at a glance.

Start a free ledger
What it does for you
Sorts every bill

Each bill lands in one of 12 groups, like rent, food or travel. You do not have to set up any rules first.

Shows each month

See what you spent this month next to last month. Big changes stand out, and you can read the short guide to learn more.

Plain numbers, no jargon

Setup takes about 5 minutes. Plans cost $4 a month when the 30-day free trial ends.

Fictional demo — no real accounts or payments.
